outcome: Endothelial function (measured by Flow-mediated dilatation (FMD) change (%))
cohort: The study included 104 women aged 20-30 years who had only one live birth at Bolu Abant Izzet Baysal University Training and Research Hospital between January 2016 and January 2017, comprising groups with a history of preeclampsia (n=34), GDM (n=37), and uncomplicated deliveries (n=33).
finding: Women with a history of preeclampsia or gestational diabetes mellitus demonstrated significantly lower flow-mediated dilatation (FMD) change (%) compared to women with uncomplicated deliveries, indicating increased cardiovascular risk.
cross-section timing: N/A (measurements were taken at a single point in time, but the specific timing relative to the participants' births between Jan 2016 and Jan 2017 is not stated)
